_comment: Site profiles for the screening switch. The active profile is chosen by JES_SITE_MODE (1/prod = internal JAS, unset/0/demo = public demo); 'default' is used only when JES_SITE_MODE is unset. Every key here overrides the built-in profile of the same mode in screening_core/site_mode.py, so an operator can repoint a site without a code change.
